The 30 September digest, written by Moss, gives the number as **#8841**. It says Mateo Quiroga submitted it for the Newark Door 14 check-in kiosk problem, and that you escalated it to platform engineering.

Check it before you file the follow-up. In #strategic-pod on 1 July, you wrote that you closed out ticket #8841 with support over a kiosk browser-cache issue for a different Vantorre problem. Either the number was reused or one of the two references is wrong. I couldn't confirm it from a ticket record, because the Vantorre Group tickets folder is empty.
